Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个男孩名字叫孟子。孟子和孟子的妈妈两个人住在很穷的农村。他们住的地方旁边是个墓地，墓地老是有很多人祭拜。因为人们在祭拜，他们一直在哭。孟子和孟子的妈妈住在这里才一个星期就觉得受不了了，而且害得孟子的学习。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候：在古代
- 而且害得孟子的学习：害得孟子的学习不好，害得 + harmful result

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，古代 already expresses a time period, so adding 的时候 is redundant.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 有一个男孩名字叫孟子：有一个男孩叫孟子，when 名字叫 introduces a person’s name, it needs a pause after the noun or a possessive structure; here the simpler pattern is noun + 叫 + name.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 孟子和孟子的妈妈两个人：孟子和他的妈妈两个人，after mentioning 孟子, use 他的 to show that the mother is Mengzi’s mother without repeating the name.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住在很穷的农村：住在一个贫穷的农村地区，住在 needs a clear place phrase, and 农村地区 is a more natural place noun in this context.
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 老是：常常，老是 usually carries a negative or complaining tone; the repeated visits to the cemetery are described neutrally here.
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 害得孟子的学习：影响了孟子的学习，害得 must be followed by the person affected and a harmful result clause; 影响了孟子的学习 directly expresses harm to his studies.
7. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 住在这里才一个星期：在这里才住了一个星期，use 了 after 住 to mark that this stay of one week has been completed before the characters reach the point of feeling unable to endure it.
8. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 因为人们在祭拜，他们一直在哭：因为人们在祭拜，所以他们一直在哭，because this sentence presents crying as the result of the worship, use the paired cause-and-effect connector 因为……所以…….

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundantly formed under the teacher's rule.
名字叫 needs a pause or separate clause here, whereas 有一个男孩叫孟子 is a correct complete pattern.
Repeating 孟子 within the same noun phrase is unnecessary; 他的妈妈 correctly refers back to Mengzi.
住在很穷的农村 is already grammatical and natural enough, although the replacement is also acceptable.
老是 can appropriately convey the repeated, bothersome activity near their home and is not erroneous here.
害得 must be followed by a person and a harmful result, so 害得孟子的学习 is incomplete.
住在这里才一个星期就觉得受不了了 is a valid description of an ongoing stay, so 了 is not required.
Under the teacher's conjunction rule, 因为 introducing this cause requires the matching 所以.
